newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary's Gardenia acquires stake in Austria's CASA.
newsitem.headline: Hungary's Gardenia acquires stake in Austria's CASA.

text.p: Hungarian curtain factory Gardenia Rt, a candidate for bourse-listing, said on Wednesday it had acquired a 48 percent stake in Austria's CASA Vossen GmbH.
Gardenia bought the stake in CASA by raising the company's issued share capital to 40 million Austrian schillings, it said in a statement.
"The company (Gardenia) decided to acquire the stake to expand the choice of home textile products, to increase domestic choice and to acquire new export markets," it said.
Financial details were not released and the company was not available for immediate comment.
In addition, Gardenia raised the issued share capital of two of its wholly-owned subsidiaries, it said.
The capital of trading unit Denia Textilkereskedelmi Kft by 40 million forints to 308 million forints, effective April 1.
The capital of its Vienna-based subsidiary Gardenia Textilhandel GmbH by an equivalent of 50 million forints from the current 500,000 Austrian schillings, effective April 15.
Gardenia received a go-ahead from the Budapest Stock Exchange in early March to list and expects trading in its shares to start in April.

The company recently completed a successful capital market transaction under which it sold 222,000 own shares and issued 400,000 new shares, all with 500 forints face value, at 1,465 forints-per-share subscription price.
Before the transactions Gardenia said the funds it was raising would be spent on new investments and acquisitions.
